payload.purpose: Make a nuanced explanation feel obvious through restraint, precision, and protected thinking time.
payload.targetViewerState: Calm, oriented, and confident that the idea is understood rather than merely advertised.

grammar.hook: Open with the cleanest surprising distinction or useful question.
grammar.escalation: Add one conceptual layer at a time without artificial stakes.
grammar.proof: Use a single precise label, diagram, or source-grounded example.
grammar.reveal: Allow the insight to land in speech before a minimal visual lockup.
grammar.payoff: Restate the governing principle with maximum visual quiet.
grammar.cta: Prefer a low-pressure next step; omit it when the source contains none.

pacing.protectedPausePolicy: Preserve rhetorical, comprehension, and emotional pauses unless they exceed the quality gate.

caption.typographyGrammar: Quiet sentence-case captions with selective term emphasis and generous margins.

bRoll.policy: Only use an insert when the idea cannot be understood as clearly from speaker and type.

audio.musicBehavior: Optional licensed tonal texture with no rhythmic pressure.
audio.sfxBehavior: Silent by default; one soft reveal accent is the maximum.

brandConstraints: Favor approved neutral surfaces and one brand accent.
Preserve whitespace even when more brand elements are available.
accessibilityConstraints: Captions must never overlap the face or platform controls.
Motion must remain understandable with reduced-motion enabled.

failureClasses.label: Clarity obscured
failureClasses.description: Design adds concepts or hierarchy not warranted by the explanation.

failureClasses.label: Pause overridden
failureClasses.description: Motion, music, or cutting fills necessary comprehension space.

failureClasses.label: Minimalism as emptiness
failureClasses.description: Restraint removes the one visual aid required for understanding.

failureClasses.label: Typographic imprecision
failureClasses.description: Line breaks or emphasis change the meaning of the explanation.

failureClasses.label: Unearned motion
failureClasses.description: An accent appears without a semantic reveal or transition.

renderFallbacks: Fall back to a stable centered crop and precision captions.
Remove the optional music bed when voice separation is uncertain.
provenanceRules: Diagrams and labels must derive only from source meaning.
Reference traits may guide policy but reference media and identity markers are excluded.
